== Template:Item/Stats ==

Displays the character stat modifiers section of an item tooltip (Str/End/Dex/Agi/Int/Wis/Cha/Res), plus optional weapon stats (Damage/Delay/Range).

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''str''' || 0 || Strength modifier
|-
| '''end''' || 0 || Endurance modifier
|-
| '''dex''' || 0 || Dexterity modifier
|-
| '''agi''' || 0 || Agility modifier
|-
| '''int''' || 0 || Intelligence modifier
|-
| '''wis''' || 0 || Wisdom modifier
|-
| '''cha''' || 0 || Charisma modifier
|-
| '''res''' || 0 || Resonance modifier
|-
| '''damage''' || (none) || Weapon damage (only shown if provided)
|-
| '''delay''' || (none) || Weapon delay in seconds (only shown if provided)
|-
| '''range''' || (none) || Weapon range (only shown if provided)
|}

=== Examples ===

'''Armor (stats only):'''
<pre>
{{Item/Stats
|str=10
|end=15
|dex=12
|agi=8
|int=5
|wis=4
|cha=6
|res=10
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Stats
|str=10
|end=15
|dex=12
|agi=8
|int=5
|wis=4
|cha=6
|res=10
}}

----

'''Weapon (with damage/delay):'''
<pre>
{{Item/Stats
|str=20
|end=10
|int=20
|wis=20
|res=6
|damage=30
|delay=3.0
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Stats
|str=20
|end=10
|int=20
|wis=20
|res=6
|damage=30
|delay=3.0
}}

----
